about: Points that differ from the registry, for a person to check on the cue page (Robert, 2026-11-22: 'make an interface or highlight those differences in the camera cues page for human input'). Source: notes/2026-11-12-camera-page-positions.md. 2026-11-22: 18 named buildings looked up on OpenStreetMap by hand (Robert: '2b: yes'); OpenStreetMap data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

ws-c00f642d.name: Pretare (Monte Vettore)
ws-c00f642d.what: the camera's own point on the operator's webcam page (Scenari Digitali); the registry point is at Castelluccio, 8.4 km away

ws-d1869e67.name: Millau
ws-d1869e67.what: the Météo Millau station; the page calls this camera 'Webcam Station'
ws-d1869e67.quote: Longitude : E 03° 03' 44" / Latitude : N 44° 06' 35" / Altitude : 475 m

ws-cccd794f.name: Monte Subasio (Foligno)
ws-cccd794f.what: the camera's own point on the operator's page: Scenari Digitali's own building in Foligno

ws-294b3385.name: Marineo
ws-294b3385.what: the MarineoMeteo station (sensors 12 m up, on a roof); the station's server runs this webcam

ws-23cb6dda.name: Esine
ws-23cb6dda.what: the owner's Google pin for the Meteo Esine station; the webcam (pointing 185 deg) is listed with the station's equipment
ws-23cb6dda.quote: Latitudine 45.9256° N Longitudine 10.2472° E Quota 270 m s.l.m.

ws-9d272a29.name: Stenimachos (Naoussa)
ws-9d272a29.what: the station's point; the station mast shows on the next roof in the frame, and the camera points north-west

ws-eb420456.name: Alfàbia (Mallorca)
ws-eb420456.what: the Balears Meteo station on the summit tower of the Serra d'Alfàbia (the page gives 1054 m, its header 1015 m; the terrain there is 1002 m)
ws-eb420456.quote: Cordenadas: 39º 44´07" N y 02º 42´51" E - Altitud 1.054 metros

ws-c72938d7.name: Piano Battaglia
ws-c72938d7.what: the camera's own point in the operator's webcam catalog (Weather Sicily), which also gives a pointing: yaw 190.8, pitch 5.4, field 72.8 deg

ws-52a44492.name: Pennapiedimonte
ws-52a44492.what: the station on the roof of the Bar Dea Maja Cafè, which hosts both the webcam and the station

ws-14893013.name: Morsko
ws-14893013.what: the station's 4.5 m pole, which carries the camera (facing north-west); the owner's two points are 41 m apart

ws-e4c561a7.name: Guado di Coccia
ws-e4c561a7.what: the Rifugio Guado di Coccia hut by the chairlift's top station at the pass (OpenStreetMap's pass node is 70 m east; the network's station point 204 m west)

ws-4038dc46.name: Burg Oberkapfenberg
ws-4038dc46.what: Burg Oberkapfenberg, the castle above the town; the camera faces north-east over the town, so it is on the castle's NE side (click there if you can tell)

ws-e9b1072a.name: Frabosa (Monte Malanotte)
ws-e9b1072a.what: the chairlift's top station on the Monte Malanotte summit (OpenStreetMap's summit node is 50 m west)

ws-948cfada.name: Arolla
ws-948cfada.what: the Grand Hôtel & Kurhaus; the camera looks south from its south side
ws-948cfada.quote: Grand Hôtel & Kurhaus, 6 Route de la Forêt, Arolla (OpenStreetMap)

ws-f02ddb94.name: Pörtschach - Parkhotel
ws-f02ddb94.what: the Parkhotel's own point; the red dot sits on the building OpenStreetMap calls Parkhotel (Elisabethstraße 22). The camera is on the west end of the hotel roof, looking WSW along the lake

ws-908b1b2b.name: Decontra (Agriturismo Pietrantica)
ws-908b1b2b.what: Agriturismo Pietrantica, which hosts the webcam and the station; the camera looks W-NW over the Orta valley

ws-9fd1e89b.name: Burg Hochosterwitz
ws-9fd1e89b.what: Burg Hochosterwitz; the camera is on the west side of the castle top, above the church spire, facing about west

ws-dd6898bd.name: Hirben (Niederdorf)
ws-dd6898bd.what: Aparthotel Hirben, Rienzstraße 5 (the hotel's own point is 11 m away)

ws-97ed71c2.name: Hotel Sommer (Füssen)
ws-97ed71c2.what: the wing west of the hotel's signed front (the camera sees the 'Sommer' front to its left); OpenStreetMap's Hotel Sommer building (Weidachstraße 74) is 40 m north-east

ws-0c9a16d7.name: Falkensteiner Schlosshotel (Velden)
ws-0c9a16d7.what: Schloss Velden; the camera is on the roof by one of the two lake-side (east) corner towers. Click that corner if you can tell which

ws-3621d05d.name: San Vito Romano
ws-3621d05d.what: via Santa Maria, the street of the Al Campanile holiday home (no. 15, below the bell tower); the red dot is the camera's overlay point, 4 m away
ws-3621d05d.quote: Via Santa Maria, San Vito Romano (OpenStreetMap)

ws-a6e71537.name: Bad Tabarz
ws-a6e71537.what: the Hotel am Burgholz, Am Burgholz 30, from which the camera looks SW-W over the town; the red dot is the weather station's point
ws-a6e71537.quote: Hotel am Burgholz, 30 Am Burgholz, Bad Tabarz (OpenStreetMap)

ws-6d0e50b7.name: Karditsa (Titagion)
ws-6d0e50b7.what: the Titagion Boutique Hotel in Agios Athanasios, Lampero; the camera looks west down over the village to the lake
ws-6d0e50b7.quote: nrg - Titagion Boutique Hotel, Agios Athanasios, Lampero (OpenStreetMap)

ws-dd1c91b3.name: SAO RAS Zeiss-1000
ws-dd1c91b3.what: the Zeiss-1000 telescope tower (not the small 0.6 m dome near it); the camera looks at the BTA dome

ws-ad794f47.name: Mountain Living (St. Valentin)
ws-ad794f47.what: the Mountain Living apart-hotel, Hauptstraße 27; the camera is on its roof facing about 220 deg
ws-ad794f47.quote: Mountain Living Apart-Hotel, 27 Landstraße - Via Vitt. Veneto (OpenStreetMap)

ws-4c519f3a.name: Allgäuhaus Wertach
ws-4c519f3a.what: the Kolping-Allgäuhaus complex (Kolpingstraße); the camera is on the house whose roof looks SW down the meadow to the village

ws-3464350a.name: Izaña north
ws-3464350a.what: the Izaña Atmospheric Observatory; the five cloud cameras stand in the weather garden 40-60 m west of the main building, so click the garden if you can see it

ws-ae569b08.name: Izaña Güímar
ws-ae569b08.what: the Izaña Atmospheric Observatory; the same weather garden as the north camera, 40-60 m west of the main building
